patternScenarios.prompt: An insurer prices each customer a unique premium using driving-app telematics and claims history.
patternScenarios.hint: Segment of one — tailored to the individual.

patternScenarios.prompt: A drone inspects power lines, chooses flight paths, and flags damaged insulators without a pilot.
patternScenarios.hint: It perceives, decides, and acts in the world.

patternScenarios.prompt: A hospital estimates 30-day readmission risk so a nurse can schedule follow-ups.
A bank chatbot answers balance questions and routes angry callers after sentiment scoring.
patternScenarios.hint: Language and conversation are the core capability.

patternScenarios.prompt: Nightly jobs flag employee badge-swipes that don't match that person's usual hours and doors.
patternScenarios.hint: Deviation from a baseline — not reading a photo.

patternScenarios.prompt: Customs software reads passport MRZ codes from booth camera stills.
patternScenarios.hint: Extracting identity from an image is Recognition / OCR.

patternScenarios.prompt: A traffic-light controller learns timing policies in simulation, rewarded for fewer stops.
patternScenarios.hint: Trial-and-error with a reward is Goal-Driven.

patternScenarios.prompt: A retailer finds that diapers and beer sell together on Friday nights and uses that association for shelf layout.
patternScenarios.hint: Market-basket association lives in Patterns & Anomalies.

patternScenarios.prompt: Speech-to-text turns clinic dictation into a draft EHR note.
A music app builds a different Discover mix for every listener.
patternScenarios.hint: Hyperpersonalization, not Conversation, if there is no dialogue.

phaseScenarios.prompt: The sponsor wants 'AI like the demo we saw' but cannot name a KPI or who is harmed if it is wrong.
phaseScenarios.hint: No business problem, success metric, or ethics framing yet.

phaseScenarios.prompt: You discover the 'labels' are free-text comments from 2014 with no rubric, covering 12% of cases.
phaseScenarios.hint: Can this data even support the question?

phaseScenarios.prompt: A teammate scaled every numeric column using min/max of the entire CSV, then split train/test.
The data scientist has tried six architectures this week and wants to keep peeking at the holdout until one 'wins'.
phaseScenarios.hint: Model development governance — protect the test set.

phaseScenarios.prompt: Accuracy is 98.9%. Fraud is 1.1% of rows. Leadership wants to go live tomorrow.
phaseScenarios.hint: Evaluate with the right metrics and a business Go/No-Go.

phaseScenarios.prompt: After launch, precision slowly dies as a new fraud tactic appears. Nobody owns retraining.
Legal asks whether a protected class is encoded via ZIP code before any model is trained.
phaseScenarios.hint: Responsible AI constraints belong in Business Understanding — and continue later — but the question is being asked at the start.

phaseScenarios.prompt: You compare a champion production model to a challenger on 5% of live traffic with a kill switch.
